Container.Name: keyhunter
Container.Overview: Private Xbox wishlist with IGDB search, Eneba and Driffle offers, price history and ntfy alerts. Import the linux/amd64 image from the GitHub v0.2.1 release. See the repository installation guide.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Internal HTTP. Use a private HTTPS NPM origin in production; no public port forwarding.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Local appdata directory; owner UID/GID must match the container (default 10001:10001). SQLite must not use SMB/NFS. Choose the local pool.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Optional protected config directory containing ntfy.env. Restrict file access to the container UID. Never paste secrets into template variables.

Config.Name: ntfy configuration file
Config.Description: Optional owner-readable file containing NTFY_URL and NTFY_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Daily jobs per shop
Config.Description: Daily cap for product and discovery jobs per shop. One job makes up to three public requests.

Config.Name: Private HTTPS origin
Config.Description: Exact HTTPS origin of your reverse proxy, without a trailing slash or path.

Config.Name: Allow loopback HTTP
Config.Description: Keep false behind an HTTPS proxy. HTTP is supported only for explicitly allowed loopback development.
